FN-A1NKQS-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 311
Committee: County and Municipal Sponsor: Representative Alan Baker
Government
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/17/2023
House Bill 311 as introduced provides further for the approval of the application of a plan for a
modified existing solid waste management facility by local governing bodies. This bill would
not otherwise affect state or local funding.
